Pointer cast of byte-offset arithmetic reaching a struct member via an array-indexed element + sibling field + offset (e.g. `(CMirror *)(p[1].create_event + 0x1c)` -> `&this->mirror`). Replace with the named field/array access in a .keep.

'pCVar2[1].create_event + 0x1c' walks 1 x sizeof(CDemonActor) (0x158) + offsetof(create_event) (0x78) + 0x1c = 0x1ec, which is exactly offsetof(CActorDestination, persistent_event_flag). Ghidra had no CActorDestination type here and reached the field by index arithmetic; write it as ((CActorDestination *)pCVar2)->persistent_event_flag (§de-pun/§12). Ambiguous: CBarrier::effect_class_name_list[132], CChain::pull_wav_name[56], CCurtain::let_go_event[88] also has a field there — confirm the real class from the .asm before rewriting.
